(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS Land Acquisition Notices

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No. : DS/MN/LB/05/AQ/WPP/PhI.Ext./12 Land Ministry Ref. No. : 4-3/11/2022/CEB/142. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land or servitude to be acquired :

The lands allotment called Moondrupanaithennanthoddam, in total extent of about 2.7731 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 1, 2 & 3 in Plan No. Cadastral - 940060, Block No. 03, Sheet No. 06 and prepared by Surveyor General situated in the Village called Olaithoduvai in the Grama Niladari Division No. 60 of Olaithoduvai, in the Divisional Secretary's division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province.
Plan No. - Cadastral - 940060, Block No. 03, Sheet No. 06

01. Lot No. 1 Name of the land: Moondrupanaithennanthoddam; Present use of the Land: Garden contain 30 Coconut trees (15-20 years); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Samanudeen, Erukkalampiddi, Mannar; Extent: 0.0753 Hectare. 02. Lot No. 2 Name of the land: Moondrupanaithennanthoddam; Present use of the Land: Garden contain 2 Palmyra trees (15-20 years);

Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Sheedu Salmaan Farees; Extent: 0.9395 Hectare. 03. Lot No. 3 Name of the land: Moondrupanaithennanthoddam; Present use of the Land: Garden contain 2 Palmyra trees (15-20 years); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mohideen Ghani Abdool Jaffaar; Extent: 1.7583 Hectares. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.00 a.m. on the 23rd day of April 2025 at Divisional Secretariat Mannar Town. And further you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 16th day of April 2025 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for the compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. M. Pංඋൺඍඁൾൾඉ, Divisional Secretary, Mannar Town. Divisional Secretariat of Mannar Town, 14th March, 2025. EOG 03 - 0170/1
